meta.name: agent-analytics
meta.description: Analytics your AI agent can actually use. Track, analyze, run A/B experiments, and optimize across all your projects via CLI. Includes a growth playbook so your agent knows HOW to grow, not just what to track.

copy.tagline: 追踪分析项目数据并自动优化增长策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要让AI帮你分析数据并自动执行增长策略。
copy.tagline_en: Track project analytics and auto-optimize growth strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to analyze data and execute growth strategies automatically.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你为网站或应用添加分析追踪、查看流量和转化数据、运行 A/B 实验，并通过命令行分析用户行为。
howto.when: 当用户想给项目添加分析追踪、查看网站表现、运行 A/B 测试或询问“网站怎么样了”时触发。

say.text: 帮我给我的网站 my-site 添加分析追踪。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成设置并生成追踪代码。

say.text: 查看 my-site 过去 7 天的流量和用户趋势。
say.note: Claude 会调用 stats 命令返回数据。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 A/B 实验，测试两个按钮文案。
say.note: Claude 会指导你创建实验并设置变体。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you add analytics tracking to websites or apps, view traffic and conversion data, run A/B experiments, and analyze user behavior via CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to add analytics tracking, check project performance, run A/B tests, or asks "how's my site doing?".

say_en.text: Help me add analytics tracking to my site my-site.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through setup and generate tracking code.

say_en.text: Show me traffic and user trends for my-site over the last 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude will call the stats command and return data.

say_en.text: Create an A/B experiment to test two button texts.
say_en.note: Claude will help you create the experiment and set up variants.
